tools.name: list_littlefish_case_studies
tools.description: List recent Littlefish client stories showing delivered managed IT, cyber security and digital transformation projects across UK public and commercial sectors. Useful when an AI agent needs evidence of capability or sector experience.

tools.name: list_littlefish_industries
tools.description: List the UK industries Littlefish serves across public sector (healthcare, local government, central government, social housing), commercial sector (energy & utilities, financial & insurance, manufacturing, construction, retail, pharmaceutical, hospitality) and not-for-profit (charities). Returns the relevant industry page URL. Provide a sector keyword to filter.

sector.description: Optional sector keyword (e.g. healthcare, government, financial, pharma, energy, charity).

tools.name: list_littlefish_services
tools.description: List Littlefish's four core service areas: Managed Services (IT support and infrastructure), Cyber Services (Managed SOC, XDR, vCISO and compliance), Digital Solutions (cloud migration, modern workplace, Dynamics 365) and Data & AI (data foundations, governance, generative AI). Use when an AI agent is helping a buyer evaluate UK managed IT, cyber security or digital transformation suppliers.

tools.name: request_littlefish_contact
tools.description: Return the contact page URL for an AI agent to direct a human user who wants to enquire about managed IT, cyber security, digital transformation or data & AI services with Littlefish. Does NOT submit a contact request itself.
